request.subject: ICON:ACTION:LAY_EGG

layers.text: Remove the brown strap and the grey patch from the egg, so the egg is one smooth pale cream eggshell with a few big dusty blue speckles and cool grey shading, with nothing brown. Change nothing else: keep the egg's shape, the nest ring of pale cream bones under it, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
